alignments.note: The comparative *As* the ASV supplies before this bare nominal is the noun's own under rule 33, and the *a* is rule 15's; the verbless clause's construction-supplied copula joins this predicate nominal (rule 20), leaving the unit discontinuous under rule 25.
Construct noun; the chain is recast as an English possessive, so no *of* is written (rule 29).
Rectum written as the possessive; an English possessive expression takes the determiner of the possessor, so the supplied *a* stands with this word (rule 29).
No conjunction stands in the Hebrew for the apodosis connective, so the supplied *So* answers to no morpheme (rule 14's closing sentences); the ASV's italic corroborates it under rule 7.
Noun with its own *a* (rule 15), discontinuous around the attributive.
The waw's clause is recast as a relative, and the relative is the connective the ASV wrote for it (rule 17).
Participle recast as *is without*, with the copula of rule 20; the margin's literal 'turneth aside from' was read and set aside under rule 38.

review_notes: The competing reading takes *So is* as one supplied run; the copula is licensed by the verbless construction (rule 20) and so joins the predicate nominal, leaving only *So* `added`.
